# Licences of the third-party icon redraws

Each file here is a derivative of the upstream artwork and keeps its licence. The originals
(PNG/SVG, with their LICENSE files) are in `src/<app>/`; URLs in `src/SOURCES.tsv`. The ArtCraft
apps are MIT OR Apache-2.0: the A2 drawings are offered under the same terms (an SPDX/licence
comment sits in every SVG). The ArtCraft names/marks themselves are not used in WolOS surfaces
(doctrine: no upstream names visible); only the file names here are internal.
